notes:
Faster on big sets, a nightly backup, and copying a typical sheet's takeoff.

- **Copy a sheet's takeoff to typical sheets.** Right-click a thumbnail →
  Copy this sheet's takeoff to… Tick the sheets; each copy is lined up with
  that sheet's drawing, keeps its conditions, and one ⌘Z undoes it all. A sheet
  it cannot line up is named so you can check it.
- **Sheets you have seen come back at once.** Every sheet, once drawn, is kept
  on disk, so going back to it — or reopening the job tomorrow — takes a blink
  instead of up to ten seconds. Zooming shows the sheet straight away and
  sharpens it, with no blank flash. The heaviest sheets draw about twice as
  fast, and memory on a 62-sheet set peaks about a third lower and settles
  back down once you stop.
- **Nightly backup.** Once a day the library and settings are copied to
  iCloud Drive (or OneDrive), keeping two weeks. Help → Back Up Library Now
  does one immediately; Help → Show Backups opens the folder. You are told if
  backups stop working.
- **Damaged files fix themselves.** If the price book, jobs list or settings
  are ever damaged, NXG Takeoff puts back last night's copy at startup and
  keeps the damaged one. A job file that will not open offers the copy this
  Mac kept from earlier (the last five, ten minutes apart).
- **Keyboard takeoff:** M run, S area, N count, W wall, X deduct, U auto count,
  K scale, Z detail scale box. ; finds any condition by name.
- **Bid check** now catches a condition measured but never priced, one priced
  but never measured, and sheets of a discipline you skipped.
- **Re-pricing** shows when the bid took each price and when the book changed.
- **Money fixes from a full review — some open bids will price differently,
  correctly:**
  - Volume marks are priced per cubic yard, not per square foot.
  - An assembly part with per set to 0 adds only its "+" amount.
  - A line with no quantity but an adder, minimum or crew × days is now charged.
  - A minimum no longer turns a credit or deduct positive.
  - An assembly row's Tax, waste, adder, contingency and minimum now apply to its parts.
  - A mark moved out of every group stays out, rather than pricing in a group of the same colour.
  - Re-pricing from the book now changes typed lines, not just marks.
  - Templates keep their prices and condition types (re-save older templates once).
  - A proposal for part of the job taxes only that part's taxable material.
  - Job cost counts lines in no group; buy lists and POs leave out sub work.
  - The CSV export shows deducts as negative and roofs sloped.
- **Plain messages.** Every error now says what happened and what to do, not
  a code.
- A file that is not a PDF, is empty, or is password-protected says so and how
  to fix it, instead of nothing.
- A crash of the drawing side reloads the window and offers your unsaved work.
- Built on a current Electron and PDF engine, with two years of security fixes.
